note: Partition of the repo for targeting (spark, scans, ownership): every tracked file lies in exactly one context (tl arch rule context-map-cover). The scope map in docs/OWNERSHIP.md is generated from this file's paths, owner and rule by `tl arch --index` (rule ownership-fresh).

contexts.name: kernel
contexts.rule: `engine/tools/selftest.sh` stays green; API additions update `engine/kernel/API.md`; `engine/JOURNAL.md` is the engine's history

contexts.name: kit
contexts.rule: references nothing outside itself; `tl arch` module-walls; `engine/kits_lab` is the kit's layout lab

contexts.name: rigs
contexts.rule: references nothing outside itself; `tl arch` module-walls

contexts.name: style
contexts.rule: references nothing outside itself; `tl arch` module-walls

contexts.name: cores
contexts.rule: a game core (docs/design/DIRECTIONS.md, direction 10): may use the kernel API, kits, rigs and style; packs reach it through one kernel entry; `engine/cores/rink/native/thirdjam*` is thirdjam's source byte for byte (patches listed in native/PATCHES.md); `engine/tools/selftest.sh rink` stays green

contexts.name: packs
contexts.rule: every house game passes all verbs (`tl check --tier full --only packs`); `engine/packs/README.md`

contexts.name: ui
contexts.rule: `engine/tools/ui.sh selftest`; reads job directories as `contracts/JOB.md` defines them

contexts.name: cards
contexts.rule: `tl cards check`; a card names only what its seed shows (`contracts/CARDS.md`)

contexts.name: engine-tools
contexts.rule: usage headers agree with verbs.json (`tl arch` verbs-contract); `tl check --tier full`

contexts.name: devx
contexts.rule: `tl check --tier fast`; `perf/` measures under load and starts only processes it ends

contexts.name: docs
contexts.rule: docs in the same commit; `docs/generated/**` only from its generator

contexts.name: frozen
contexts.rule: frozen history: do not build on it

contexts.name: boot
contexts.rule: `tl check --tier full --only world`: every game of `engine/boot/games.json` hashes in one world as it does alone; the exe exports (`docs/EXE.md`)
